edits.new_text:
if (isinstance(result, dict)
            and result.get("schema") == "xar.ck3.declarable-read-unavailable.v1"
            and result.get("step") == "query-declarable-wars"
            and result.get("accepted") is False and result.get("status") == "unavailable"
            and result.get("business_submission") is False
            and result.get("terminal_native_rejection") is True
            and result.get("declarable_candidates_available") is False
            and result.get("query_sequence") is None and result.get("declarable_wars") == []):
        source = result.get("source_frame")
        rejected = result.get("native_rejection")
        if (not isinstance(source, dict) or not isinstance(rejected, dict)
                or rejected.get("native_step") != "query-declarable-wars"
                or rejected.get("native_error") != "CK3 declarable-war query is unavailable"
                or rejected.get("expected_native_revision") != source_frame.get("native_revision")
                or not isinstance(rejected.get("native_request_id"), str)
                or not rejected["native_request_id"]
                or any(source.get(k) != source_frame.get(k) for k in (
                    "snapshot_id", "revision", "native_revision", "date_raw",
                    "actor_character_id", "episode_run_id", "bridge_pid"))):
            raise ValueError("unavailable declaration query lost its original source")
        rid = rejected["native_request_id"]
        pending = state["pending_query"]
        if (state.get("last_closed_unavailable_request_id") == rid
                or isinstance(pending, dict) and pending.get("unavailable_request_id") == rid):
            return view(state_dir, {}, source_frame)
        state["pending_query"] = {
            "query_sequence": None, "unavailable_request_id": rid,
            "unavailable_source": {**source, "native_request_id": rid},
            "source_snapshot_id": source_frame.get("snapshot_id"),
            "source_native_revision": source_frame["native_revision"],
            "source_date_raw": source_frame["date_raw"],
            "source_bridge_pid": source_frame["bridge_pid"]}
        _save(state_dir, state)
        return view(state_dir, {}, source_frame)

def _completed_no_declare_advance(outcome: dict) -> bool:
    """An ordinary planner decision already completed before the new event."""
    plan = outcome.get("plan")
    decision = plan.get("decision") if isinstance(plan, dict) else None
    return bool(
        isinstance(plan, dict) and plan.get("policy") == "one-life-turn-v1"
        and plan.get("selected_step") == "life-advance"
        and isinstance(decision, dict)
        and decision.get("policy") == "general-native-war-entry-battle-prior-v1"
        and decision.get("outcome") == "NO_DECLARE"
        and decision.get("automatic_declaration_enabled") is False
        and decision.get("advance_contract") == "native_life_advance"
        and decision.get("native_power_assessment_consumed") is True
        and decision.get("campaign_root_context_consumed") is True
    )

if pending.get("unavailable_request_id") is not None:
        state["last_closed_unavailable_request_id"] = pending["unavailable_request_id"]
